title: OpenClaw与Ollama在代理式AI中的应用：迈向完全自主且可扩展的AI代理系统
summary: 本文提出代理式AI的分层架构，区分推理、编排和执行层。通过OpenClaw与Ollama的全栈集成，验证了持久记忆、工具使用和自适应决策等能力源于系统级集成而非单一模型。讨论了可扩展性、安全、隐私和评估挑战，并发布模型、代码和数据集以支持复现和基准测试。
summary_en: This paper proposes a layered architecture for Agentic AI, separating inference, orchestration, and execution. Validating the OpenClaw-Ollama full-stack system, it shows capabilities like persistent memory and tool use emerge from system integration. Discusses scalability, security, and evaluation challenges, releasing models and code for reproducibility.
